starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

grid='''8 8 8 8 7 7 8 8 8 8 7 7 8 8

8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 7 8 8
8 8 8 7 7 8 8 8 7 8 8 7 8 8
8 8 8 8 8 8 8 7 8 8 7 8 7 8
8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 7 8 8 8 8
8 8 8 8 7 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8'''
a=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in grid.splitlines()]
R,C=len(a),len(a[0])
# count 7 connected comps 4 and 8, bbox/size
for conn in [4,8]:
 seen=set(); comps=[]
 for r in range(R):
  for c in range(C):
   if a[r][c]==7 and (r,c) not in seen:
    stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cc=[]
    while stack:
     x,y=stack.pop();cc.append((x,y))
     for dx in [-1,0,1]:
      for dy in [-1,0,1]:
       if dx==dy==0 or (conn==4 and abs(dx)+abs(dy)!=1):continue
       p=(x+dx,y+dy)
       if 0<=p[0]<R and 0<=p[1]<C and a[p[0]][p[1]]==7 and p not in seen:seen.add(p);stack.append(p)
    comps.append(cc)
 print(conn,[(len(x),(min(i for i,j in x),max(i for i,j in x),min(j for i,j in x),max(j for i,j in x))) for x in comps])
PY
